name: Path of Least Existence
source:
A very short visual novel speculating the nature of existence.

Contains four endings with certain doom, existential dread and even some hope.

[From [url=https://indifferential.itch.io/path-of-least-existence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部非常短的视觉小说，思考存在的本质。

包含四个结局，带有一定的厄运、存在的恐惧，甚至还有一些希望。

[来自[url=https://indifferential.itch.io/path-of-least-existence]Itch.io[/url]]
